job_title: IT Procurement/ IT Service Management - TA180
sub_category: Chuyên môn Công nghệ thông tin khác
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or above in Information Technology, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
benefits: Fixed 13th-month salary, with total annual income equivalent to 16–18 months of salary
Bonuses for public holidays and Lunar New Year (Tet) in accordance with the bank’s policies from time to time
Preferential loan schemes in accordance with the bank’s policies from time to time
Attractive annual leave policy based on job level
Mandatory social insurance in accordance with labor law, plus VPBank Care insurance for employees, depending on job level and length of service
Participation in training programs based on the Training Framework for each position
Working hours: Monday to Friday, and 2–3 Saturday mornings per month

Dynamic and friendly working environment with many opportunities for training, learning, and career development; participation in various engaging cultural activities (sports competitions, talent shows, team-building activities, etc.)
description:
IT Budget Management
* Develop and manage the annual IT budget; monitor spending and adjust variances.
* Perform financial forecasting and optimize resource allocation.
* Prepare periodic budget reports and ensure compliance with approval processes.
Software License Management
* Centrally manage software licenses, track and audit usage.
* Execute processes for requesting, allocating, and revoking licenses.
Vendor Payment Control
* Review invoices and reconcile with contracts; establish approval controls.
* Ensure timely payments, maintain documentation, and prepare periodic reports.
Infrastructure & Service Contract Management
* Manage the full contract lifecycle, monitor acceptance and handover.
* Evaluate contract effectiveness and vendor performance.
Branch & ATM Network Infrastructure Management
* Deploy and monitor LAN/WAN and telecommunications connectivity.
* Coordinate new setups, relocations, and decommissioning of infrastructure; ensure continuous operations.
IT Operations Portfolio Management
* Maintain and update operational data; support reporting and dashboards.
* Track progress and follow up with relevant stakeholders
requirements_text:
* Bachelor’s degree or above in Information Technology, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5 years of experience in IT Procurement, IT Vendor Management, Software/IT Asset Management, IT Service Management, Service Governance, IT PMO, or Technology Finance.
* Experience in banking, financial services, fintech, telecommunications, or large-scale enterprises is preferred.
* Strong analytical and structured thinking, with advanced Excel skills and experience in data analysis, reconciliation, identifying discrepancies, and recommending corrective actions.
* Experience in developing, reviewing, and standardizing processes, procedures, operational guidelines, and workflows.
* Good understanding of or hands-on experience in contract management, vendor management, budgeting, procurement, asset management, or service lifecycle management.
* Ability to establish control mechanisms, identify irregularities, and transform manual activities into standardized and structured management processes.
* Ability to quickly learn new business areas, particularly software license management and technology asset management.
* Experience working cross-functionally with IT, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and external vendors.
* Good command of English; experience in large enterprises with established processes and governance frameworks is preferred.
